name: talktoads
description: Run your Meta (Facebook + Instagram) ads by talking: reports, audits, reel boosts and campaigns that start paused until you say go.

interface.shortDescription: Run your Meta ads by talking. Everything starts paused until you approve.
interface.longDescription: TalkToAds connects your Facebook ad account so you can run Meta (Facebook + Instagram) ads in chat. Ask how your ads did and get spend, results, cost per result and ROAS by campaign, ad set or ad. Run an account audit that scores wasted spend, fatigue and rejected ads. Turn an Instagram reel into a campaign, or build campaigns, ad sets and ads from scratch. Everything is created paused and only goes live after you say so. It also pauses ads, changes budgets and remembers your target CPA and brand rules.
defaultPrompt: How did my Meta ads do in the last 7 days?
Audit my ad account for wasted spend
Boost my latest reel to my website at ₹500 a day
